essence: Mid-tongue awareness, h-uttering: dissolves in calm.
Unbroken sky-gaze: stunned self wins Bhairava-form.
Dark night, dark fortnight: contemplating timira, form comes.
Eyes closed, black before: contemplating, made of that.
Any organ's strike or block: nondual void, self shines.
No drop, no emission: lone a rises, knowledge-flood.

rasa.dominant: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
rasa.justification: The gates are uncanny — tongue-uttering, closed eyes, dark fortnights, black-before-eyes — each weirdness resolving into calm, form, shining: wonder at how little it takes.

sections.SUMMARY: The gates-block: tongue mid-mouth with the h-utterance dissolving awareness into calm; unsupported body-vision wasting impurity in a moment; the moving seat's calm winning divine flood; unbroken sky-gaze stunning self into Bhairava-form; crown-sky all-Bhairava letting blaze-reality enter; duality-light known as endless-light-bearing; the deliberate darks — bad night, dark fortnight, black before closed eyes — contemplated until timira itself yields the form and made-of-that; an organ struck or blocked opening nondual void where self shines; and the lone a-syllable, no drop no emission, rising into knowledge-flood.
sections.FUNCTION: Catalogues the text's strangest apertures as reliable doors — darkness and organ among them.
sections.KEY TERMS: hoccāra (h-utterance); stabdhātmā (stunned self); timira (darkness contemplation); nāda-bindu (droplet-emission refusal); ekākṣara (lone syllable).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Sound and dark continue into letter-practices (p10); sleep-vision (p08) prefigures nidrā-practices ahead.
sections.BOUNDARY: Counts as doors only — no hierarchy of doors stated; beginners' suitability not yet addressed (that comes with upāya-talk later).
sections.EXPLANATION: An anatomy of apertures: the tongue's middle with a single h becomes a dissolving route; standing unsupported turns one's own body-vision against impurity; a moving seat shakes out divine flood; gaze unbroken across sky stuns the self into form; crown-contemplation admits blaze; duality's light becomes endless-light-bearing once known as such; and the truly odd gates — a bad night, a dark fortnight, blackness before shut eyes — are treated as equal portals, so that even darkness contemplated becomes form. The organ-practice generalizes: any sensory strike, any blocking of it, enters the nondual void where self alone shines.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh: intensity-doors list (dark sky among them); Kṣemarāja on ekākṣara; v90's sudden knowledge-flood echoes p07's flood.
